job_function: collateral and margin operations - bilateral initial margin
control_point: Regulatory initial margin for non-cleared derivatives is calculated, reconciled and disputed under the ISDA SIMM standard model or a regulator-approved alternative; the control point is the bilateral agreement of the IM amount, composition and segregation before the regulatory settlement deadline.

citations.source_name: BCBS-IOSCO, Margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives, September 2013
ISDA, Standard Initial Margin Model for Non-Cleared Derivatives, version 2.6

consequence_anchor.public_source: BCBS-IOSCO non-cleared margin framework and CFTC/SEC/ESMA/PRA supervisory remediation for missed IM calls and unsegregated margin
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: regulatory remediation, capped variation margin haircut disallowance and published enforcement fines; material disputes can delay trading capacity

commonality_rationale: Every in-scope swap dealer and financial end-user computes and exchanges regulatory IM daily under consistent SIMM parameters; public enforcement actions and ISDA dispute-resolution guidance confirm the operational commonality.
